headline: Venezuela’s OPEC Exit Is Still Only a Discussion
deck: The exit idea has been raised in conversations with U.S. officials, but no final decision has been made before OPEC’s 29 November meeting.
body: Bloomberg Law reported that the idea of Venezuela leaving OPEC has been a topic in conversations with U.S. officials. Some of the people, who asked not to be identified while discussing private information, said no final decision had been made. [E1]

Reuters separately reported that the Trump administration encouraged Venezuela and Iraq to consider leaving OPEC. [E2] OPEC’s June decision reaffirmed its overall production level through 31 December, and the group is scheduled to hold its next ministerial meeting on 29 November. [E3][E4]
